newsitem.title: UK: UK shares start lower, weighed down by weak Dow.
newsitem.headline: UK shares start lower, weighed down by weak Dow.

text.p: UK shares inched lower at the opening bell, as investors fretted Wall Street could be on the verge of a more substantial downside correction after Friday's near 60-point setback.
Early trading volume was light, however, as many investors awaited the Dow's open later this afternoon.
"There hasn't been a lot of selling but market makers are on their guard," the head of trading at a large brokerage said.
"People are talking about Wall Street coming off several hundred points and don't want to be around if that happens."
The FTSE 100 was down 11.8 at 4,207.0 by 0830 GMT.
